question: Which of the following drugs have properties similar to the adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH) ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: ACTH -> stimulates the adrenal cortex -> releases cortisol and other glucocorticoids -> 90% CHAIN: Tetracosáctido -> synthetic analog of ACTH -> mimics ACTH's actions -> 90%
enhanced_information: Tetracosáctido is a synthetic analog of ACTH that mimics ACTH's actions by stimulating the adrenal cortex to release cortisol and other glucocorticoids. This aligns with the consensus understanding of ACTH's mechanism of action. Lanreotide, Pegvisomant, and Ganirelix do not have properties similar to ACTH.
